title: [Regulation of alkaloid biosynthesis by transcription factor CcWRKY40 in Coptis chinensis].
authors: He, Mu; Yu, Jing-Jing; Zhang, Ke-di; Liu, Yu-Xiang; Sun, Sha; Ping, Zi-Han; Li, Xue-Gang; Zhang, Ying-Chun
journal: Zhongguo Zhong yao za zhi = Zhongguo zhongyao zazhi = China journal of Chinese materia medica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄连转录因子CcWRKY40调控生物碱合成，通过酵母单杂交和双荧光素酶验证其与靶基因启动子结合，并用分子对接预测结合位点，属于TF-DNA互作但以实验验证为主，AI/物理模拟方法较浅。
abstract: The biosynthetic pathway of alkaloids in Coptis chinensis has been preliminarily elucidated, while the regulatory mechanism of alkaloid biosynthesis remains to be thoroughly investigated. This study screened a transcription factor CcWRKY40 with high expression under methyl jasmonate induction from the previous transcriptome data of C.chinensis. To investigate the regulatory mechanism of CcWRKY40 on alkaloid biosynthesis, this study cloned CcWRKY40 and conducted bioinformatic analysis of this gene. The tobacco transformation experiment was conducted to predict the subcellular localization of CcWRKY40 and real-time fluorescence quantitative PCR was performed to analyze the tissue-specific expression of CcWRKY40. The yeast one-hybrid assay was employed to examine the interactions between CcWRKY40 and the promoters of five main functional genes. The dual luciferase assay was carried out to validate the transcriptional activation function of CcWRKY40. Molecular docking was performed to predict the possible binding sites of CcWRKY40 to promoters. The results indicated that the open reading frame(ORF) of CcWRKY40 was 951 bp, encoding 316 amino acid residues. CcWRKY40 was located in the nucleus. The RT-PCR results demonstrated that CcWRKY40 was most highly expressed in the fine roots in 1-to 5-year-old C. chinensis. The results form yeast one-hybrid and dual-luciferase assays indicated that CcWRKY40 was able to bind to the promoters of CcCNMT and Cc4'OMT and activate their transcription. The binding sites were predicted at the core domain(RKYGQK) of CcWRKY40. In summary, CcWRKY40 can bind to the promoters of functional genes CcCNMT and Cc4'OMT, thereby activating their transcription. The present study lays a foundation for elucidating the regulatory mechanism of CcWRKY40 on alkaloid biosynthesis in C. chinensis.
abstract_zh: 黄连（Coptis chinensis）中生物碱的生物合成途径已被初步阐明，而生物碱生物合成的调控机制仍有待深入研究。本研究从前期黄连转录组数据中筛选出一个在茉莉酸甲酯诱导下高表达的转录因子CcWRKY40。为探究CcWRKY40对生物碱生物合成的调控机制，本研究克隆了CcWRKY40并对其进行了生物信息学分析。通过烟草转化实验预测CcWRKY40的亚细胞定位，并采用实时荧光定量PCR分析CcWRKY40的组织特异性表达。利用酵母单杂交实验检测CcWRKY40与五个主要功能基因启动子之间的相互作用。进行双荧光素酶实验以验证CcWRKY40的转录激活功能。通过分子对接预测CcWRKY40与启动子可能的结合位点。结果表明，CcWRKY40的开放阅读框（ORF）为951 bp，编码316个氨基酸残基。CcWRKY40定位于细胞核。RT-PCR结果显示，在1至5年生的黄连中，CcWRKY40在须根中表达量最高。酵母单杂交和双荧光素酶实验结果表明，CcWRKY40能够与CcCNMT和Cc4'OMT的启动子结合并激活其转录。结合位点预测位于CcWRKY40的核心结构域（RKYGQK）。综上所述，CcWRKY40能够与功能基因CcCNMT和Cc4'OMT的启动子结合，从而激活其转录。本研究为阐明CcWRKY40对黄连生物碱生物合成的调控机制奠定了基础。
